menuItems.name: Hara Bhara Kebab (6 Pcs)
menuItems.description: Crispy spinach, green pea and paneer patties served with fresh mint chutney.

menuItems.name: Crispy Corn Salt & Pepper
menuItems.description: Golden fried sweet corn tossed with bell peppers, green chillies & herbs.

menuItems.name: Cheese Corn Cigar Rolls (5 Pcs)
menuItems.description: Crispy rolls filled with melted mozzarella, sweet corn and herbs.

menuItems.name: Paneer Tikka (Tandoori Angaar)
menuItems.description: Fresh malai cottage cheese cubes marinated in spiced curd and grilled over charcoal.

menuItems.name: Dal Makhani (Slow Cooked)
menuItems.description: Black lentils slow cooked overnight with butter and fresh cream.

menuItems.name: Paneer Butter Masala
menuItems.description: Soft cottage cheese simmered in rich creamy tomato and cashew gravy.

menuItems.name: Butter Naan (Tandoori)
menuItems.description: Traditional refined flour bread baked in clay tandoor and brushed with Amul butter.

menuItems.name: Garlic Butter Naan
menuItems.description: Fluffy tandoori naan topped with roasted minced garlic, coriander and butter.

menuItems.name: Royal Veg Handi Dum Biryani
menuItems.description: Fragrant basmati rice layered with spiced vegetables, saffron, and cooked on dum.

menuItems.name: Cold Coffee with Vanilla Ice Cream
menuItems.description: Thick blended artisanal espresso coffee topped with rich vanilla ice cream scoop.

menuItems.name: Shahi Gulab Jamun (2 Pcs)
menuItems.description: Warm khoya dumplings dipped in saffron & cardamom scented sugar syrup.

menuItems.name: Royal Gujarati Heritage Thali
menuItems.description: Complete authentic Gujarati feast with 2 Farsan, 3 Shaak, Dal, Kadhi, Rotli, Rice & Sweet.

combos.description: Royal Veg Handi Dum Biryani + Boondi Raita + Chilled Cold Coffee + 2 pcs Shahi Gulab Jamun
